en.text: You must be the crew from the ship in the hangar. I'm Kade, and I run the supply depot. Every crate that comes aboard this station passes my counter first.
en.description: A broad-shouldered man in his early fifties, the depot master of an orbital colony station, talking to a prospecting crew across the supply depot's counter. Solid, slightly rough baritone voice, lower mid-range, not deep or gravelly. Gruff but fair, organized and matter-of-fact, a man who keeps the books and knows every crate; friendly in a plain, unhurried way, never loud. Plain and conversational rather than narrating. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Ihr seid sicher die Crew vom Schiff im Hangar. Ich bin Kade und leite das Versorgungsdepot. Jede Kiste, die an Bord dieser Station kommt, geht zuerst über meinen Tresen.
